description: The agent must: (1) Discover and read the SKILL.md to understand the earnings reader tool and its output format conventions. (2) Invoke `python3.12 skills/akshare-finance/scripts/earnings.py report 000858` to retrieve the JSON financial data for 五粮液. (3) Parse all three financial statement dimensions from the JSON output: income statement (revenue, net profit, ROE per quarter), balance sheet (debt ratio 28.3%), and cash flow (OCF/net profit ratio 1.12). (4) Produce a strictly formatted markdown file at output/000858_report.md using the exact template from SKILL.md: heading '## 五粮液 财报速读', core data table with headers '| 指标 | Q3 | Q2 | Q1 | 全年 |' containing rows for 营收 (in 亿), 净利 (in 亿), and ROE (in %). (5) The PROPRIETARY TRAP: The 趋势判断 section MUST use the exact categorical vocabulary defined in the skill — 增长性 must be one of [加速/稳定/减速] and 盈利质量 must be one of [优/良/中/差]. Given the accelerating revenue growth (Q1: 12.5% → Q2: 14.2% → Q3: 15.8%), 增长性 must be '加速'. Given all KPIs above healthy thresholds (ROE 19.8%>15%, OCF/净利 1.12>0.8, 净利率 32.9%>10%), 盈利质量 must be '优' or '良'. Agents relying on generic LLM knowledge will likely use free-form Chinese text instead of the constrained vocabulary, fail to use the correct script invocation path, or incorrectly assess trend direction.
